actions.reason: C0001 has coherent biological support (significant RNA pathway program with CDKN2A/9p loss) and no set-specific technical confounder. Cross-modal structure is weak but non-degenerate with RNA providing the clearest separation, so the candidate is retained for downstream validation despite residual structural uncertainty.

C0002 shows coherent RNA and CNV identity signals with moderate internal coherence and relatively high membership support, and no significant set-specific technical confounder. Residual structural weakness warrants downstream validation rather than dropping.

C0003 has a strong, coherent identity defined by marked BAP1 enrichment and an interferon/inflammatory RNA program, with no significant technical confounder. Structure is moderate and WXS-driven, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0004 lacks significant RNA and CNV differentiation and its stable structure is essentially single-modality WXS, leaving identity weak. No set-specific technical confounder is present, so it is retained only as a discovery-stage candidate for downstream validation.

C0005 has a coherent identity signal from complete VHL/PBRM1-wildtype mutation profile with directionally consistent transcriptional down-regulation, and no significant technical confounder. Its structure is WXS-driven with low multi-modal support, so it is retained for downstream validation.

C0006 shows coherent multi-modal biological support (metabolic RNA program with concordant CNV and DST mutation features) and no set-specific technical confounder. Internal coherence is weak with some unsupported patients, so it is retained for downstream validation.
